title: 1/4 해상도 병렬 가지(W4) 추가
hypothesis: Against C2MS, 75 C2MS_W64D8 lost RR 0.127 dB, 74% of it in the 4-8 px band (52% with a Hann window; about 90% below 8 px either way) and mostly as error uncorrelated with the GT (detail gain 0.969 vs 0.973); by structure the largest share was flat regions (35% of the loss, 18% of the gain). C2MS itself also keeps most of its error as 4-8 px uncorrelated components. A third branch at quarter resolution (W4, 0.43M) adds cheap, coarse context. If that context suppresses spurious 4-8 px texture in flat regions, (A) W64D8 + W4 (1.48M) recovers more of the C2MS gain than widening did (75 W128D4, 1.67M, 78%), and (B) C2MS + W4 (3.28M) improves RR over 53 C2MS.

evidence.experiment_75: W64D8 (1.05M) RR -0.127 dB, W128D4 (1.67M) -0.201 dB against 53 C2MS; 86% and 78% of the C2MS gain over the original kept
evidence.experiment_75_frequency: W64D8 -> C2MS RR +0.127 dB by band: 4-8 px 73.6% (Hann 52.3%), 2-4 px 14.7% (CI includes 0, 12/20 scenes), 8-16 px 9.9%, above 16 px 1.2%; 4-8 px error difference 92% uncorrelated component
evidence.experiment_75_structure: share of the W64D8 loss against C2MS: flat 35.4%, fine 23.9%, small 19.9%, medium 9.7%, large complex 11.6%; flat regions kept 77% of the C2MS gain, fine/small/medium 88-89%
evidence.experiment_75_analysis_record: provenance/basis_75_analysis/ (script and numbers; QB RR test seed 42, predictions reproduced the server scene PSNR within 1e-6 dB)
evidence.experiment_29: a full-resolution branch (W3) was worse than W2; no quarter-resolution branch has been tried

arms.C2MS_W64D8_W4: original backbone + 75 W2 branch (64 channels x 8 blocks) + W4: PixelUnshuffle(4) -> 1x1 1024->64 -> 4 residual blocks at 64 channels -> 1x1 64->1024 (zero init) -> PixelShuffle(4), all three added
arms.C2MS_W4: C2MS (original backbone + 128 x 8 W2 branch, initialised exactly as 43 C2 / 53 C2MS) + the same W4 branch

comparisons.official: each arm against the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed (criteria v2.4, RR only)
comparisons.run_to_run: each arm against the 57 retrained C2MS (reference)
comparisons.retention: share of the C2MS RR PSNR gain over the original 43 C0 kept; arm A read with 75 W64D8 (86%) and W128D4 (78%)
comparisons.mechanism: the 75 frequency/structure split repeated after the run (4-8 px band, uncorrelated component, flat regions) for A against 75 W64D8 and B against 53 C2MS; reported, not a judgement

control_policy: No new control run: the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed is the official control and the 57 retrained C2MS shows run-to-run variation.

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.4: RR PSNR, SAM, ERGAS against the same-seed 53 C2MS; single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB; FR QNR/D_lambda/D_s reference only
judgement.reported: validation PSNR/SAM per epoch, RR against 53, 57 and the original, share of the C2MS gain kept, FR QNR reference, epoch time of two concurrent trainings

stages.1_screen: QB seed 42, both arms trained at the same time
stages.reading: B is the candidate for improving C2MS; A answers whether a third branch is a cheaper fix than width for the reduced branch
stages.next: seeds 43/44 or GF2/WV3 only after user approval

limits: 4-8 px detail has a period of 1-2 px at quarter resolution, so W4 is expected to act as coarse context rather than to draw that detail itself
the receptive field of W4 (4 blocks) is about 65 px, close to that of the 64 x 8 W2 branch
two trainings share the GPU; cudnn benchmark may pick different algorithms under load, which can change floating-point details but not the training recipe
expected_duration: about 5 h for both arms together (75: 115 s per epoch each with two concurrent trainings; arm B is larger than the 75 arms)
precision: FP16 AMP core training with GradScaler; FP32 transforms, loss, validation and evaluation (as 53/63)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0, earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as 53/63)
